items.stem: When selecting an Azure VM for an SAP production workload, what must you confirm first?

options.text: That the VM type is SAP-certified for the workload
options.rationale: Correct: only SAP-certified VM types are supported for SAP production workloads.

options.text: That the VM is the cheapest in the region
options.rationale: Lowest price does not guarantee SAP support or performance.

options.text: That the VM uses an ephemeral OS disk
options.rationale: Ephemeral OS disks are unsuitable for persistent SAP systems.

options.text: That the VM is in an availability set only
options.rationale: Availability-set placement alone does not make a VM SAP-certified.

items.explanation: Correct: only SAP-certified VM types are supported for SAP production workloads.
items.domain_ref: Design and implement an infrastructure to support SAP workloads on Azure

items.stem: Which component provides automatic failover fencing in an SAP HANA high-availability cluster on Azure?

options.text: Pacemaker with an Azure fence agent or SBD
options.rationale: Correct: Pacemaker with an Azure fence agent or STONITH Block Device provides fencing for HA.
Site Recovery is a DR tool, not an HA fencing mechanism.
A single availability zone provides no automatic failover on its own.
Azure Backup protects data but does not fence cluster nodes.

items.explanation: Correct: Pacemaker with an Azure fence agent or STONITH Block Device provides fencing for HA.
items.domain_ref: Design and implement high availability and disaster recovery (HADR)

items.stem: Select TWO techniques to optimize cost for SAP VMs on Azure.

options.text: Apply reserved instances or savings plans
options.rationale: Correct: reservations and savings plans reduce steady-state VM cost.

options.text: Right-size VMs based on Azure Advisor
options.rationale: Correct: right-sizing from Advisor recommendations removes over-provisioning.
Disabling monitoring harms operations and does not reduce VM cost materially.
Deleting the backup vault removes protection and is not a cost strategy.

items.explanation: Correct keys: A, B. Correct: reservations and savings plans reduce steady-state VM cost.
